title: First-run snippet cards + compact screen captures for API/SDK quickstart
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, reusable set of visual assets for the API/SDK quickstart pages that will be used across the hosted API docs, SDK readmes, and in-console first-run flow. Scope: 1) snippet cards (auth + key rotation + streaming + tool-calls) sized for inline docs and small-screen console panels, 2) 3 annotated product screenshots for the Console's first-run modal (API key creation, streaming dev workflow, tool registration), 3) two micro-animations (.gif or Lottie) showing streaming token flow and a tool-call handshake. Deliverables should be componentized in Figma so engineering can export exact pixel assets and there is a single source of truth for future updates.
acceptance_criteria: Set of 6 snippet card variants: Basic auth, API key creation, Key rotation sequence, Streaming (server+client quick example), Tool calling (function signature + example), Structured output JSON example
Each snippet card exported at 3 sizes: doc-inline (640x240), console-panel (480x180), narrow/mobile (320x140)
3 annotated screenshots with callouts matching console copy; assets exported as PNG+SVG and annotated Figma frames
2 micro-animations exported as MP4 and Lottie, under 3s each, with accessibility-friendly motion alternatives
Figma file updated with component variants, tokenized colors/spacing, and a README frame describing usage and export names
Design handoff PR created with links to Figma, sample HTML snippets, and a small stylesheet (CSS tokens) for embedding

Consider exporting a plain-text code snippet file alongside images for cut-and-paste in docs.
